title: Look Back, Correct Forward: Error Feedback Calibration for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.22872v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series forecasting models are increasingly deployed in continuously evolving environments. After a forecast is issued, future observations gradually arrive and reveal how the model has failed. Existing methods mainly treat such observations as supervision for parameter updates. However, it remains unclear whether verified forecasting errors can themselves provide causal feedback for correcting future predictions. To address this, we introduce Error Feedback Calibration (EFC), a fully test-time framework for deterministic post-hoc correction of time series forecasting. EFC constructs a Causal Error Diagonal (CED) from revealed errors of overlapping historical forecasts, providing a fresh view of the frozen forecaster's recent failure behavior. Then Cumulative Error Transport (CET) maps this error state to future residuals using cumulative estimation, while temporal out-of-sample validation controls the correction strength. Temporal R

translated_title: 回顾过去，修正未来：时间序列预测的误差反馈校准
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测模型越来越多地被部署在持续变化的环境中。当预测发布之后，未来的观测值会逐渐到来，并揭示模型在哪些方面出现了失败。现有方法主要将这些观测值当作参数更新的监督信号。然而，经过验证的预测误差本身能否为修正未来的预测提供因果反馈，这一点尚不明确。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了误差反馈校准（Error Feedback Calibration, EFC），这是一个完全在测试时运行的确定性事后修正框架。EFC从重叠历史预测的已揭示误差中构建因果误差对角线，为冻结的预测器的近期失败行为提供了一种全新的视角。随后，累积误差传输通过累积估计将该误差状态映射到未来的残差上，同时利用时间上的样本外验证来控制修正强度。
tldr: 提出了一种完全在测试时运行的误差反馈校准框架EFC，通过从重叠历史预测误差中构建因果误差对角线，并利用累积误差传输机制将其映射为未来残差修正，实现对时间序列预测的确定性事后校正。
en_tdlr: We propose Error Feedback Calibration (EFC), a fully test-time framework that deterministically corrects time series forecasts by constructing a Causal Error Diagonal from overlapping historical forecast errors and mapping them to future residuals through Cumulative Error Transport.
